title: Getting Started with Express and TypeScript
content: Express pairs nicely with TypeScript once you add @types/express. This article walks through setting up a basic server, adding middleware, and wiring up EJS as the view engine.

title: Why I'm Building a Personal Blog
content: I wanted a small full-stack project to practice routing, templating, and basic file-based persistence before reaching for a database. This blog app covers CRUD, routing params, and form handling.

title: Notes on File-Based Storage
content: Storing articles in a JSON file is a simple way to persist data without a database. It's not production-grade, but it's great for learning read/write patterns before moving to something like SQLite or Postgres.
